title: Smooth cutoff equal to 1 on B_rho(y), supported in B_{2rho}(y), with gradient at most K/rho
statement: There is a real constant K >= 0 such that for every natural number n, every point y in R^n (Rn n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n)) and every rho > 0 there is a function eta : R^n -> R with: eta is C^1 on R^n; 0 <= eta(x) <= 1 for every x; eta(x) = 1 for every x in the open ball B_rho(y); eta has compact support; the topological support tsupport(eta) is contained in the open ball B_{2 rho}(y); and ||D eta(x)|| <= K / rho for every x in R^n, where D eta(x) = fderiv R eta x and ||.|| is the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : Rn n) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∃ η : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball y ρ, η x = 1) ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ ball y (2 * ρ) ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ η x‖ ≤ K / ρ
